english_lines: Whenever I feel your gentle gaze,
I end up feeling as if I was being forgiven.
Even if it's impossible, I wish that this whisper would reach you, my beloved
Whenever I see you fighting and getting wounded,
I always end up feeling like I want to cry
y.z.t. za rre vega merfa l.n.c.a. ag zz l.n.c.a. tie hartes yor/.
y.z.t. za rre vega merfa l.n.c.a. ag zz l.n.c.a. tie hartes yor/.
Even if it's impossible, I wish that this pure wish would connect us, my beloved
When we met, a Song surged through my heart
And its excited and warm melody began to flow throughout my body
Whatever may now lie ahead, I shall hold no regrets
Holding this instant of happiness in my heart, I shall sing — Metafalica!
It is a song spoken of in the ancient legends
The story of the maiden, Rhaplanca, and the Great Divine Tree, Implanta
To their land, never once was the blessing of rain bestowed ;
In its every reach spread out naught but desolation
And its people lived out their days in never-ending thirst and despair
At the bottom of a dim abyss,
a deep breath can be heard
Come, now is the time to be free
Throwing away everything, I will become a Song
The Song floods my heart
Filling the land, the valleys, and the lakes
Soon, the lively tree that grows from the depths
Will embrace the land with its roots
I shall Sing the Song that crafts a world.
With my very own legs, I shall take
A firm step on this beloved land
And from there on, making my way forward
I shall advance unwaveringly
As they accumulate
The footsteps that I leave behind,
Shall form a record of my passage
From the top reaches of this cracked land, Rhaplanca plants the seed
Its roots unwaveringly embrace the land
And its green branches head off to extend into the skies,
Dreaming of becoming the ideal great tree
I will embrace
This precious world in my arms
Looking up to the sky,
I make a pledge in my heart
Rhaplanca sprinkles water over the land where the seed of hope sleeps
The warm fruits hanging from its branches quench the thirst of this land's people
Like they were going to become great trees bearing the lives and hope of the people
Engrave a dazzling future!
Oh, miracle of feelings,
Resound as far as you can!
He knew about Rhaplanca's pure wishes
"Please, may she fulfill these pure wishes"
And he strongly prayed to resurrect the hope in the people's hearts.

緑溢れる 静かな楽園の
その奥深くに

Since very long, long ago... Since the beginning of this world, EXA_PICO has been whispering a Song.

この声を　使徒として
伝えよ　その想い
時を越え　地上に　届く波動は
文字の無い　あなたの　綴るこの物語

与えられし　この身果つるまで

english_lines: I'll summon you to this place
Oh Song, descend upon me
Oh Song, please dwell inside my heart
And then, you'll become a Song
As an apostle, my voice
will express these feelings
In the waves crossing the time and reaching the ground
Oh, I'll play the Song of my own self
Is this wordless story you have weaved
And listening to everyone's happiness, I'll be glad at the idea of becoming a flower
I will keep singing, at morning and at night
They all are what Songs are
Until the body I was given dies away
I always think that Songs are mysterious
That Songs shake the bottom of my heart more than anything
I'll pluck and make resound my heartstrings to craft the magic of happiness
My voice rides on the wind
Kibou no shushi to naru kirakira to
And radiantly becomes the seed of hope
The future sprouting within countless hearts
Oh, I'll play the Song of my own self
Sing like the little birds, sing like the little streams
is a shapeless eternal flower you sketched
And listening to everyone's happiness, I'll be glad at the idea of becoming a flower
I'll become something good for everyone, and then I'll become a flower
I will keep singing, today and tomorrow
Blessing your future, I'll send you back to your world of origin

english_lines: The days I walked alone were something natural to me
In such a way I lived so I wouldn't destroy my own enclosed world
The mirror reflects a fake smile
Opposite to the clouds inside my heart
Many people wandering under the sky
To protect myself from them, I lived a life locked within myself
The happiness that me has come to know now
Is something I'll reach if I reach out with my arms
It's just at the other side of the gate, I don't need to overdo it
Let us talk with truthful words
Thus, to this world, and to the people I meet
I'll give them the Song of love that tied the flowers together
Taisetsuna dareka to yorokobi tomoni sureba
If I share my happiness with someone precious
My enclosed world will extend further before I notice
The eyes will reflect a sincere smile
If I open my heart
Many people with thousands of feelings
Me ni suru kagayaki wo ryoute de dakishimetai
I want to embrace the radiance in their eyes with my hands
I will never be the only special one here
And everyone certainly feels the same way
It's just at this side of the gate, I don't need to overdo it
And we can understand each other with truthful words
Dakara kono sekai to koko de au hito to
Thus, with this world, with the people I meet
I will sing the Song of love that tied the flowers together
Sometimes we may disagree (Sometimes we may take different paths)
While we turn our backs to others (While we try to hide our tears)
Kenka mo suru keredo (Kirai to iu keredo)
We may quarrel, but... (We may say that we hate each other, but...)

The singing birds, (The soaring birds)
*I want them to express my feelings, (I want them to honestly convey them)

May be joined tomorrow (May meet tomorrow)

It's just at this side of the gate, I don't need to overdo it
Let us meet and talk through our true selves
Soshite kono sekai to koko de au hito to
Thus, with this world, with the people I meet
I will sing the Song of love that tied the flowers together
